score_definition: Ratio of MAE to a training-median baseline. 0.55 raw nightly price on a listing holdout, 0.25 raw occupancy, 0.20 time-split raw nightly price when last_review dates exist. Area-median error is reported and is not part of the selection score, because training on area medians wins that column automatically. Below 1 beats predicting the median.
split: GroupShuffleSplit by listing id, 20% test, seed 42. Time split keeps the newest 20% of listings that have a last_review date.
